meta.name: Project UFO
meta.description: A smug TV host and a small-town ufologist work to uncover the origins of an alleged UFO sighting, splitting the nation in a storm of doubts and beliefs.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Polgar invites Sokolik to speak on his show, where he reveals a mysterious photo of an unidentified submerged object he believes to be extraterrestrial.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Julia struggles with Sara's sleepwalking terrors, and Polgar meets with Josef — a small-town farmer who claims he's seen foreign entities near his home.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Wera travels to Truskasy to scoop the breaking story from under Polgar's nose with Sokolik's help. Julia and Polgar uncover a shocking new eyewitness.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The state holds a conference to unveil Polgar's findings, but when Julia and Sara visit the lake, a hidden truth about Antek's disappearance resurfaces.
